name: Avocado-soybean unsaponifiables
short: In a meta-analysis of placebo-controlled osteoarthritis trials, adverse events were no more common than with placebo. No interaction data were found.
text: In a meta-analysis of randomised placebo-controlled trials in hip and knee osteoarthritis, adverse events were no more common with avocado-soybean unsaponifiables than with placebo (relative risk 1.02, 95% CI 0.83 to 1.25). No interaction data were found in the cited sources.

citations.label: Simental-Mendía et al., 2019, Int J Rheum Dis
citations.title: Efficacy and safety of avocado-soybean unsaponifiables for the treatment of hip and knee osteoarthritis: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized placebo-controlled trials.
